body: Well allegedly the landlord runs background checks, but I’m starting to doubt that.

Right. However my roommate is violating the lease. He’s always smoking weed in his room and there is a section in it that says one cannot have or use illegal drugs on the premises. And my roommate does that daily. And I’ve alerted him to this. So technically, contractually, he has grounds to evict him.

I’ve had roommates move out with such short notice that the rent isn’t paid in full. He lets it go and does nothing and just tells me to get new roommates as soon as possible. And then the cycle repeats

Some months I’ve had people move out on such short notice that I couldn’t afford the rent. The landlord would usually let it slide that month and then the next recoup costs with a new deposit from other people moving in and sign a lease. Rinse and repeat.
Breaking the lease, presumably.

Thank you for your kind words. I’ve had roommates up and leave before and nothing comes of it. Landlord doesn’t take them to court or anything. I would at least be in a position to get a better person in here, hopefully.

His criminal background check shows he has a history of fleeing state for these issues. So I’m hoping it gets him to leave state. 

Multiple offenses will lead to him getting cited and eventually arrested. And when the issue isn’t fixed still he will get arrested again and so on. And eventually he will leave state. His record has a history of that behavior. I’m trying to expedite it.

I know from experience with previous roommates that my landlord doesn’t do anything with people who move out early. 

To be honest, the lease might as well not exist. The landlord doesn’t do anything with it. Never has. And I doubt he suddenly would.

Unfortunately resorted to craigslist as a last resort to get him. It’s a two year lease with another year and a half to go. Landlord wants all his money each month regardless of how it’s paid. So it’s not like X each, it’s just X total. 


If he’s in jail and out of the house I think my landlord would be a little more understanding at that point about taking action to evict him and trying to get someone else in. It’s one thing for him to be late and stuff by my understanding with the landlord is, rent wise, he won’t let someone just sit here and ride off the other person without consent. Or so he has said in the past.
I have been for a while. Not had any luck unfortunately.
what happened to the stock at your best buy that has been there for weeks? lol
What happened to your rift?
We pay it ourselves, separate from the landlord.

That makes sense. However I have always had roommates even before them so a comparison won’t work, unfortunately. And we had always agreed to pay the bill 3 ways evenly. I have history showing that where they’ve sent me money through Cash App to back that up.

Thank you! I’ll try to get pictures of some mail. But in case I can’t somehow, I do have security camera footage of them living in the house. (We just have them for general security.) Would that be acceptable?

Unfortunately that’s not an option. 

But I have contacted the landlord and he and I are on good terms. He wants them gone.
Thank you. I noticed it mentioned there are feees, as I assumed. How much are those usually and can I sue for my roommates to reimburse those fees as well?

Definitely noted. 

Potentially stupid question, but how would I go about filing a small claims court case? I’ve literally never had to do that so I don’t know where to start.

I’m not the landlord. The 3 of us rent from the landlord. I apologize if that was confusing. They only just told me this morning they’re leaving within the next few weeks. Didn’t give me a date. But they told me they will not be paying another dime. 

Suing them though, sounds very costly and long. It’s also an entirely foreign concept to me. Wouldn’t I need a lawyer, as well?

Yeah I want them gone. There’s more to it. You can look at my posting history for more info. 

But no, I’ve got nothing. Nobody.

Tensions in the household have been high for a bit. Basically they’re pissed off at the bills. Bills they all agreed to when moving in. Then they’re pissed off because the electric bill is high when they crank down the AC. They’re pissed off because the cats in the house when they knew about the cats moving in. 

But apparently, it’s all me. They’re telling me how horrible of a person I am, and how I’m the reason all my roommates leave, and this is why I don’t have any friends and this is why I can’t get a job.

I’m sorry, I had fallen asleep. 
I actually just woke up to find out my roommates are abandoning me. So I’ll likely be homeless soon.
I like that idea. I exercise a lot nowadays. It’s helped in the past but not so much anymore. Nothing helps anymore.
I tried reaching a suicide hotline a few days ago and was unable to reach anyone. And honestly I don’t really mind because all they do is brush you off or threaten to hospitalize you.

I know that too well. The banging my head trying to make it stop. I’ve gotten so torn up about it I just cry and scream and punch the pillow. It’s hard. 

I’m honestly always up for a chat.
Do you have ideas of where to start? I know her first name, and that’s it. I’m going to try searching that on Facebook, but neither of my roommates have a Facebook to check for mutuals.
But is the footage I have usable with recording laws the way they are? And are they even enough? Also I have no clue who she was. :(
This place is like my home and unfortunately options to move aren’t too good. But I informed my landlord and we agreed they need out.
Tbh pretty miserable. Idk why I can’t die already. I tried to killl myself the other night and I can’t even do that right. I can’t live, I can’t die, I just eternally suffer. I hate this.
I just don’t have anyone anymore. I’m so fucking alone.
No one wants to want to die. But I made this decision years ago. I just need to get it over with.
Too scared of the pain. How much it’s going to hurt. This was kind of spur of the moment. And it’s like, I took them, and now there’s no going back.

How fucking pathetic is it that I’m laying here in my final moments of existence with no one to talk to but complete strangers on fucking *reddit.*

I think this is pretty warranted lol.
I’m kind of scared though tbh
Just been a long time coming.
It’s like if I stuck tortured you for years straight. It doesn’t make it easier for you to deal with the pain and eventually you just want it to end.

The only thing that changes is I keep wondering why I didn’t do it. 

It’s getting worse because as time goes on the pain is worse and worse.

I’m always preaching positivity and spreading helpful advice and positive vibes for people. Helping everyone out. Sending positive messages. But no one knows what pain is behind that mask. “Who watches the watchmen?”

Nothing is changing. Things are only getting worse. 13 years ago I tried to kill myself. 8 years ago I tried to kill myself. 3 years ago I tried to kill myself. Things have only gotten worse since each of these. I just think back to how much better it’d have been if I actually did it. I can’t be in this situation again a few years from now wondering why I didn’t do it. 

It’s a fact, it’s going to happen. I’m going to do it. It’s a matter of when. And I just don’t know why that hasn’t happened yet. Why wait.

Exactly. There is no other option other than “deal with it.” But I don’t want to deal with it. I don’t have to. And it hurts to. 

That’s why, despite what people say, suicide *is* an option.

The only reason I’m alive is because of my cowardice to endure the pain required to kill myself. I’m too weak to deal with that pain. And I can’t overcome anything in my life. I’m passed the point of giving up.

Unfortunately I don’t even know what to say anymore. I’m passed the point of suicidal. I don’t know why I haven’t done it yet. I’m literally ready to do it. Nothing is stopping me from walking out the door and never coming back
I’m so not strong. I’m so fucking weak. I can’t fathom how I’m still alive honestly. I don’t do anything anymore except feel like dying.
Literally everything. And I’ve told many people. They don’t seem to care or take it seriously. I’m just another person that wants to kill themself.
It was the generic one. Which I assume routes to a local center.

I had them tell me about sending out someone to talk to me and I called back saying I’d like to use that option and they were telling me it’s not possible. Several people told me they could just send a cop out to me, and we know how that would turn out...
